components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action control; touch-sized on phones and compact on desktop.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), opacity 140ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .9; box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet supporting action with structural rather than promotional emphasis.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; transition: background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A raised, readable capture field with an explicit focus state.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" aria-label="Item title" placeholder="What needs attention?">
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 280px; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 16px/1.5 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-subtle); transition: border-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), box-shadow 220ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: A high-contrast active route with tonal selection and a sparse accent mark.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 6.5%, transparent); color: var(--foreground); font: 600 13px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; text-decoration: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border-subtle); } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--accent-color, currentColor); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: A compact group for peer views, with visible pressed state and named icon-only mobile options.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--muted); } .ds-segmented button { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 500 12px/1.25 var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Raised Surface
components.description: A restrained content surface one tonal step above its workspace.
components.css: .ds-surface { width: 280px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-raised); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); font-family: var(--font-geist-sans), sans-serif; } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-surface p { margin: 0; max-width: 65ch; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-surface:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Threadmap feels like a calm working surface where plans, records, and decisions remain connected without becoming visually loud. Warm paper and deep charcoal establish the environment; precise rules, compact typography, and small tonal shifts organize dense operational information. The interface is restrained rather than austere. Controls feel tactile through short state changes and shallow depth, while the user-selected accent appears sparingly in focus, selection, and small identifying marks. The system favors legibility, continuity, and honest status over decorative spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, near-neutral light and dark work surfaces.
Compact but readable hierarchy with tabular numerals for dates, counts, and measurements.
Tonal grouping before elevation; floating depth is reserved for overlays.
Touch-sized controls on phones and denser controls on precise-pointer layouts.
One user accent that identifies state without becoming small body copy.

rules.name: The Opaque Copy Rule
rules.body: Supporting copy uses an opaque semantic tone with accessible contrast; opacity is reserved for decorative marks and truly disabled states.

rules.name: The Sparse Accent Rule
rules.body: The user accent identifies state and focus. Foreground text remains ink or chalk unless the chosen accent has been contrast-validated for that exact surface and size.

rules.name: The Quiet Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Increase weight before adding color, and increase size before adding ornament.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface receives either a structural edge or meaningful elevation; stronger depth is reserved for state and hierarchy.

dos: Do keep primary tasks obvious through weight, position, and state before adding more color.
Do use semantic opaque copy tones for every readable label, including compact dates and metadata.
Do keep phone controls at least 44 by 44 pixels and preserve safe-area spacing.
Do use mono or tabular numerals only for code, dates, time, price, rank, and measurement.
Do preserve short opacity and color feedback in reduced-motion mode.
Do reserve final shell geometry while authentication or route data resolves.
Do lazy-load security and media dependencies that a local-only session does not need.
donts: Don't use the configurable accent as unchecked small text.
Don't stack opacity onto muted text to create hierarchy.
Don't add decorative grain, gradient text, generic glass cards, or bounce easing.
Don't make essential actions hover-only or icon-only without an accessible name.
Don't introduce a new card, radius, or motion language for one route when a shared primitive already owns it.
Don't preload every remote image or initialize reCAPTCHA before cloud functionality is requested.
